name: Website Design
title: Website Design for Local Businesses
headline: Website design for local businesses that brings in jobs.
intro: A fast, phone-first website built around the searches your customers make, with a call button on every page and forms that ring your phone.
price: From $1,500. Live in about two weeks.
includes: A homepage, a page for each service and a page for each town you work in
A call button at the top of every page
Quote and contact forms that text and email you
Fast on phones, with your logo, photos and reviews
We write the words. You check them before launch.
who: Local service businesses with no website, or one that doesn't bring in work.

name: Local SEO
title: Local SEO for Service Businesses
headline: Local SEO that puts you at the top of Google in your town.
intro: Google ranks pages, not whole websites. We build a page for each service and each town, so you can show up for every search your customers make.
price: Included in every site. Monthly upkeep is part of Growth.
includes: A page for each service, like "stump grinding" or "AC repair"
A page for each town you work in
Titles, descriptions and Schema code on every page
Your Google Business Profile linked to your site
A sitemap sent to Google on launch day
who: Owners who want to show up for "[your service] near me" searches.

name: AI Search (AEO)
title: AI Search Optimization (AEO) for Local Businesses
headline: Get named when people ask ChatGPT who to hire.
intro: More people ask AI who to hire. AEO (answer engine optimization) sets up your site so ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI answers can read it, trust it and name you.
includes: Schema code that tells AI your name, services, area, hours and reviews
An llms.txt file that sums up your business for AI tools
Straight answers to the questions your customers ask
Pages that match how people ask questions out loud
Updates when AI search changes
who: Businesses that want to be the answer, not one of ten blue links.

name: Booking and Payments
title: Online Booking and Payments for Service Businesses
headline: Online booking and card payments, right on your site.
intro: Customers book a time and pay a deposit without calling. Card payments run through Stripe, and receipts and reminders go out for you.
includes: Online booking that fits how you schedule
Deposits and invoices paid by card through Stripe
Receipts and payment reminders sent for you
Reminder texts and emails before each job
Hooks into the booking app you already use, if you have one
who: Businesses that lose jobs to phone tag or chase payments at the end of the month.

name: Google Business Profile
title: Google Business Profile Setup and Management
headline: A Google Business Profile that shows up on the map.
intro: Most local searches end on the map, not a website. We set up or clean up your Google Business Profile and link it to your site so the two help each other rank.
includes: Profile claimed, checked and filled in
Services, hours, service area and photos added
A link to the right page on your site
Monthly posts and photo updates
A simple way to ask happy customers for reviews
who: Businesses with an unclaimed, empty or out-of-date Google listing.

name: App Store App
title: Your Business App in the App Store and Google Play
headline: Your business in the App Store and Google Play.
intro: Every site we build installs on a phone like an app. For $1,000 more, we list it in the App Store and Google Play under your business name.
includes: Your logo on your customers' home screens
Listed in the App Store and Google Play
Opens full screen, like any other app
Updates with your site, no extra work
Store listing text and screenshots done for you
who: Businesses with repeat customers, like barbershops, salons and maintenance plans.
